parameters.content:
## AAC Admin Command Boundary

Private webhook called only by the Cloudflare Worker. Attach a Header Auth credential that validates `X-AAC-Admin-Secret`, plus the existing BigQuery credential.

Campaign launch accepts 1–200 active linked doctors from active verified WordPress practices, or a presentation/demo cohort. The dispatcher processes up to 50 recipients per run, so larger campaigns continue in later runs. Campaigns require exactly three topics with approved central image records and support immediate, ten-minute, or scheduled invitation release. Presentation recipients use `doctor_demo_...` aliases so production doctor identities are not overwritten.

Any future invitation time stores the campaign as `SCHEDULED` until the invitation dispatcher releases it at or after `invitation_send_at`. Presentation/demo campaigns are marked `preview_only = TRUE`; their interview transcripts are saved, but article generation, review requests, marketing review, and publishing are intentionally blocked.

Commands are idempotent, state-checked, and audited before n8n continues orchestration.

Dashboard marketing approvals require written evidence and a current article version. An approved article proceeds through the existing publisher workflow.

parameters.sqlQuery:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.admin_commands` (
  idempotency_key STRING NOT NULL, action STRING NOT NULL, actor_email STRING NOT NULL,
  entity_id STRING NOT NULL, requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, completed_at TIMESTAMP, payload JSON
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links` (
  marketing_review_link_id STRING NOT NULL, article_id STRING NOT NULL, secure_token_hash STRING NOT NULL,
  status STRING NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expires_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  first_opened_at TIMESTAMP, responded_at TIMESTAMP
);
ASSERT NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.admin_commands`
  WHERE idempotency_key = @idempotency_key
) AS 'This command was already processed.';
ASSERT (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles` a
  JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaigns` c USING (campaign_id)
  JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.practices` p ON p.practice_id = a.practice_id
  JOIN `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.doctors` d ON d.doctor_id = a.doctor_id
  WHERE a.article_id = @article_id AND a.campaign_id = @campaign_id AND a.doctor_id = @doctor_id
    AND a.status = @expected_status AND a.current_version = CAST(@expected_version AS INT64)
    AND a.status IN ('DOCTOR_APPROVED', 'DOCTOR_AUTO_APPROVED', 'MARKETING_REVIEW')
    AND c.require_marketing_approval = TRUE
    AND p.active = TRUE AND UPPER(COALESCE(p.publisher_type, '')) = 'WORDPRESS'
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(p.website_domain), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.wordpress_base_url')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.credential_name')), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND ((p.practice_id = 'practice_test_001'
        AND JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.wordpress_base_url') = 'https://apexparent.hostmanpowered.com/test001')
      OR (p.practice_id != 'practice_test_001'
        AND UPPER(COALESCE(JSON_VALUE(SAFE.PARSE_JSON(p.publisher_config_reference), '$.mapping_status'), '')) = 'VERIFIED'))
    AND (a.campaign_id != 'campaign_test_202609_aac_prestonwood_pilot_2026_09_23'
      OR LOWER(d.email) = 'jdold@apexdp.com')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.article_versions` v
      WHERE v.article_id = a.article_id AND v.version_number = a.current_version
    )
) = 1 AS 'The article changed, does not require marketing approval, or is not ready for its configured publisher.';
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.marketing_review_links`
SET status = 'RESPONDED', responded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE article_id = @article_id AND status IN ('READY', 'OPENED');
MERGE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.approvals` T
USING (
  SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS approval_id, @article_id AS article_id,
    'MARKETING_REVIEW' AS approval_type, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS responded_at
) S
ON T.article_id = S.article_id AND T.approval_type = S.approval_type AND T.status = 'PENDING'
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET status = 'APPROVED', responded_at = S.responded_at, response = @reason
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT
  (approval_id, article_id, approval_type, status, requested_at, responded_at, response)
  VALUES (S.approval_id, S.article_id, S.approval_type, 'APPROVED', S.responded_at, S.responded_at, @reason);
UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.articles`
SET status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED', marketing_approved_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE article_id = @article_id AND status = @expected_status
  AND current_version = CAST(@expected_version AS INT64);
UPDATE `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.campaign_doctors`
SET status = 'MARKETING_APPROVED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
WHERE campaign_id = @campaign_id AND doctor_id = @doctor_id;
INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.workflow_events`
(event_id, entity_type, entity_id, event_type, event_timestamp, source_system, workflow_execution_id, payload)
VALUES (GENERATE_UUID(), 'article', @article_id, 'marketing.approved_by_admin', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 'admin_dashboard', NULL,
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(@actor_email AS actor_email, @reason AS evidence, CAST(@expected_version AS INT64) AS version_number, @idempotency_key AS idempotency_key)));
INSERT INTO `apex-marketing-n8n.automated_article_creation.admin_commands`
(idempotency_key, action, actor_email, entity_id, requested_at, completed_at, payload)
VALUES (@idempotency_key, 'approve_for_marketing', @actor_email, @article_id, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(),
  TO_JSON(STRUCT(@campaign_id AS campaign_id, @doctor_id AS doctor_id, @reason AS evidence, CAST(@expected_version AS INT64) AS version_number)));
COMMIT TRANSACTION;
SELECT TRUE AS ok, 'MARKETING_APPROVED' AS status, @article_id AS article_id;
